ignoreValues.reason: js-row's padding-left hover-shift can't convert to transform without restructuring the JS-templated grid, because .row-tick is an absolutely-positioned sibling anchored to the row's left edge -- a transform on the row would drag the tick along with it and break the reveal effect. Confirmed lead-card (no such child) converted to transform cleanly; this one is a scoped, evaluated exception, not a default.

The .shelf-note hover-reveal (line ~235) animates max-height because the note text has variable, unknown length -- height:auto can't be transitioned, and max-height with a generous ceiling is the standard technique for revealing unknown-height content without squashing/distorting it the way scaleY would. Domain-appropriate exception, not an oversight.
